# saferm purge

Permanently remove items from archive

| Name | Short | Type | Default | Env | Description |

| `--older-than` |  | str |  |  | Purge items older than duration (e.g., 30d, 24h, 1w) |
| `--force` | `-f` | bool |  |  | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--all` |  | bool |  |  | Purge everything |
